name: application-drawer
title: Drawer
description: Slide-in side panel with a header, scrollable body slot, and cancel/confirm footer driven by a typed prop contract.
useWhen: Editing a record or filling a multi-field form without navigating away from the current page.
The content is too long for a compact dialog but doesn't need a full page.
You want a panel that slides in from the edge of the screen and stays anchored while the page beneath is dimmed.
avoidWhen: The action is a simple yes/no confirmation — use the lighter Dialog component instead.
The content should remain part of the page flow — use an inline expandable section instead.
Users need to compare the drawer content against the underlying page simultaneously without dimming.
responsiveBehavior: The drawer is full-height and anchored to the trailing edge with a max width; on narrow viewports let it grow to full width so form fields stay usable.
accessibility: The panel uses role='dialog' with aria-modal='true' and is labelled by its header title id.
The close button carries an explicit aria-label since it is icon-only.
Focus should move into the drawer on open and return to the trigger on close (implement in your own open/close logic).

variants.title: Drawer
variants.description: Edit-profile side panel with a header, scrollable form body, and cancel/save footer.
accessibility: Form fields keep visible labels; the close icon button has an aria-label since it carries no visible text.

variants.title: Drawer (Dark)
variants.description: Slide-in side panel adapted for dark surfaces with the same header, body, and footer structure.
accessibility: Field labels, input borders, and button text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
